question: Using the provided 16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant (ASV) table, calculate beta diversity between sample groups and identify significantly different taxa.

expected_output.guidelines: Coordinates must match the reference within +/-0.05 per axis; each axis may be globally sign-flipped and column order may differ.
R^2 and F-statistic must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error; Pr(>F) need only agree in significance direction (p < 0.05); row and column order may differ.
log2FoldChange and padj must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; row and column order may differ.
